elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) ... provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Assistance available for up to 6 months
elements.evidence: for a period of up to six (6) months following the Termination Date
return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data and other Confidential Information of the Company then in HDI's possession or control

elements.element: Return within 30 days of expiry/termination (not a later request)
elements.evidence: within thirty (30) days after the Termination Date, return to the Company
in a commonly used, machine-readable format
(c) thereafter delete all such Content, user information, customer data and Confidential Information from its systems
and certify such deletion to the Company in writing
up to six (6) months following the Termination Date
within thirty (30) days after the Termination Date, return to the Company

reasons: The inserted 4.3 supplies every preferred element: up-to-six-month assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return of Content and customer data running from the Termination Date, machine-readable format, then deletion and written certification.

'commonly used, machine-readable format' is substantively the preferred 'standard machine-readable format'; if the reviewer wants literal alignment, 'standard' can be swapped in, but this is a wording nuance for the rationale rather than a deviation.

The 'at the Company's request' condition attaches only to transition assistance (limb (a)); the data-return, deletion and certification duties in (b) and (c) remain unconditional, so the request trigger does not swallow the mandatory return mechanic.

Insertion is a single concise new clause for an agreement that was silent on exit; no existing term, the termination-notice mechanic, or the Termination Payment schedule is altered, and defined terms (HDI, Company, Termination Date, Content, Confidential Information) are used consistently.
